full_prompt_en: A square oil painting presents the close head and shoulders of a fair-skinned youth against a very dark, muted green-brown ground. The figure fills most of the frame and turns toward the left, with the face shown in three-quarter profile and the chin tipped sharply upward. Wide eyes follow something beyond the top-left edge; the parted lips and lifted brows give the expression a quiet intensity. Abundant copper and golden-brown curls gather around the forehead, ear, and nape, catching warm highlights one lock at a time. Soft light falls across the forehead, nose, cheek, and pale neck from the upper left, while the far side of the face and the thick hair disappear gradually into the surrounding shadow. A rich saffron-orange garment wraps the shoulders below the neck. Its folded fabric catches bright yellow touches and deeper red-brown creases, creating a second warm mass beneath the face. The background stays nearly featureless, with only subtle tonal variation and a suggestion of a rectangular darker field behind the head. Fine oil blending makes skin luminous and rounded; smaller, more deliberate strokes define individual curls and the edges of the drapery. The darkest values surround the silhouette, so the upward gaze and lit face become the immediate center. The composition is tightly cropped yet spacious above the eyes, allowing the direction of attention to continue beyond the frame. Overall the image combines restrained dramatic light, warm color, and careful naturalistic modeling in a still, contemplative scene.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形油画在极暗、低饱和的绿褐色背景前呈现一名皮肤白皙的少年的头肩近景。人物占据画面大部，向左转身，面孔呈四分之三侧面，下巴明显上扬。睁大的眼睛追随左上方画外的事物；微张的嘴唇和抬起的眉毛令表情安静却强烈。丰厚的铜色和金棕色卷发聚在额前、耳旁与后颈，一绺绺接住暖色高光。柔光从左上方落在额头、鼻子、脸颊和浅色颈部，而脸的另一侧和浓密头发逐渐没入周围阴影。浓郁的藏红花橙衣料裹着颈下双肩。折叠的布面有明亮黄色笔触和更深的红褐色褶缝，形成面孔下方的第二团暖色。背景几乎没有具体物件，仅有轻微色调变化，以及头部后方一块较深矩形区域的暗示。细腻的油彩晕染使肌肤发亮而圆润；更小、更明确的笔触界定单绺卷发和衣料边缘。最暗的明度围住轮廓，因此上望的眼神与受光的脸立刻成为中心。构图紧密裁切，却在眼睛上方留下空间，让注意力方向延伸到画外。整幅画以克制的戏剧性光线、暖色和细致的自然主义塑形，构成静止而沉思的场景。
style_prompt_en: Classical oil painting uses smoothly blended flesh tones against a nearly black green-brown ground. A single warm directional light picks out rounded planes and lets edges soften into shadow. Copper, gold, saffron, cream, and muted umber form a concentrated warm palette with small luminous accents. Curving locks and folded fabric receive finer, more visible strokes than the softly modeled skin. A close crop, high contrast around the focal area, and a reserve of darkness above and behind it create a poised, contemplative rhythm. The paint appears polished but retains subtle brush traces in texture-rich areas; depth is carried by gradual tonal transitions rather than hard outlines.
style_prompt_zh: 古典油画把平滑晕染的肤色放在近乎黑色的绿褐底上。单一暖色方向光挑出圆润的形体转折，并让边缘柔和地没入阴影。铜色、金色、藏红花色、奶油色与低饱和赭褐构成集中的暖色调，间有小面积发光重音。卷曲线条和折叠布料比柔和塑形的肌肤显露更细、更清楚的笔触。近景裁切、焦点周围的高反差，以及上方和后方保留的暗色空间形成端正沉思的节奏。油彩表面显得精致，但质感丰富处仍留细微笔痕；纵深主要由渐变色调而非硬轮廓承载。
theme_en: A curly-haired youth looking upward against a dark ground
theme_zh: 一名卷发少年在暗色背景前向上凝望
name: Guido Reni
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
